answer: The agentmon pane classifies via tools/monitorcore/monitorcore/liveness.py:classify_agent. Stall requires orchestrator_state=running plus heartbeat or process_signal. An 11-hour-finished agent with an equally old artifact mtime renders finished, not stalled. A mtime-only record is undecidable. A mtime-only mutant reproduces the statusline defect (stalled) and is rejected. SUCCESS:TST-0152
